messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Wilton & Bain Team,

Your executive-search work across energy, infrastructure and industrial leadership aligns closely with my background in regulated, asset-intensive environments. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
